quick.html:
This description came from @pinballguru in a Pinburgh 2017 thread. In order to ensure it doesn’t get lost forever, I’m adding it to the Rulesheets category.

Shaq Attaq is a “Set the Table” kind of rule set. Players should use their first two balls to qualify the Modes and Multiball. Avoid starting any modes since you want them to run simultaneous, along with Multiball. If you can qualify all (4) modes and Multiball then you will find a hidden feature at mode start. Plunge a ball for “Alley Oop” when you want to save the mode start. Each Alley Oop shot also awards 1 Game Ball.

If you can get to that point (all 4 modes and Multiball qualified) before ball 3, go ahead and shoot the ramp to start the modes. On last ball, I would also go ahead and start the modes if they any waiting. During the mode(s), try to relock all balls into the ramp. Doing so (any Regular Multiball) awards Jackpot and lights Super Jackpot. Concentrate on the Vari Target for “Game Balls” and when the Mode Timer gets low, shoot the spinner (HORSE) to restart the mode timer. The only value in the HORSE mode is to keep all of the other modes going. When a ball gets to the top flippers, always try for the Drop Target.

Once you have played the four main modes, the “Finals” will light. Make sure that you have at least 5 Game Balls before starting this mode. You can earn Game Balls by completing the 1-2-3-4-5 feature and always say “NO” to a trade. When you start the finals, the game will prompt you to whether you want to take a risk. If you say “No”, then the mode will be worth 100M. However, if you say “Yes”, then you have the option to spend 5 Game Balls to play for 300M or spend 10 Game Balls to play for 500M.

If you get this far, then you need to change your strategy and try to complete the 5 hidden features, and at the same time, try to accumulate Game Balls. When you get “5”, always say “NO” to the trade prompt until you have EXACTLY 14 Game Balls. The award for 14 Game Balls is “Double Your Score”. Regarding the Hidden Features, since this is an End of Game bonus, it’s too risky for tournament play as a main strategy, however after you have played through the modes, it becomes important, since qualifying the modes the second time through gets harder. You can also play for “Slammin Jammin by spelling “SHAQUILLE” then going into Tip Off hole. This starts a three ball wizard mode where each switch scores 5M (3M Hard/10M Easy).

The Hidden Features are: 1- Take 5000 twice in Tip Off (Tournament Mode always has this as the first Tip Off each ball)(Take 3 times when set to “Hard”) 2- Get 1 Rebound (Drop Targets after 5X) 3- Playing Multimode level 5 (Start all 4 regular modes and Multiball at same time) 4- Relocking all active Multiballs in ramp during regular Multiball. 5- Get a ball into Hole during Drop Target MVP mode.

Finding 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 hidden features awards 10M, 30M, 100M, 300M, 1B respectively at End of Game.

When set to the tournament setting, Shaq Attaq eliminates all random features. You always are offered 5,000 (LEFT) or 5 Basket Points (RIGHT) the first time each ball, then 5M the second time, etc. All players get the same sequence. If the tournament director forgot to set the game to “Tournament”, please don’t blame the game. As mentioned above, the real failure on Shaq was forgetting to address the automatic Multiball on last ball when in Tournament mode if you haven’t played regular Multiball yet.

sections.title: Quick strategy synopsis
sections.html:
Collect all of one type of item around the game (horse heads, MVP trophies, basketballs, or shot clocks) to light a mode at the right ramp. Light multiball at the right ramp by shooting into the swiveling Basket anytime during single ball play. Bonuses are given for starting multiple modes and/or multiball at once. MVP mode (shoot center drop target repeatedly) is the hardest, but most valuable. The right standup target in the upper playfield gives letters in Shaquille: spell it to qualify Slammin Jammin frenzy multiball at the upper playfield's left upkicker.

The below picture of Shaq Attaq's playfield was taken from the VPX recreation by 32assassin et al.

children.title: Skill shot
children.html:
The shooter lane will light one or more options for awards available when you plunge the ball. If the light is moving between more than one, it will lock in as soon as the ball is plunged.

Alley Oop is always available. The ball is fed to the right flipper. Shoot the swiveling Basket within about 10 seconds to score 8 Basket Points and 1 Game Ball. Both of these are described in more detail later in the guide.

If at least one Event was qualified on a previous ball, one option for the skill shot will be Event, which starts all modes currently lit at the right ramp.

The Lock option is only available immediately after shooting the right ramp with the Multiball event lit. That right ramp shot counts as lock 1; you must use the plunger to lock balls 2 and 3, then multiball begins.

children.title: Event modes
children.html: A total of 7 different Events can be started at the right ramp.

children.title: Standard events
children.html:
Standard events are qualified by collecting all three of an item around the playfield: horse heads, MVP trophies, basketballs, and clocks. At the start of the game, all instances of every item will be lit. Once a mode has been played once, only 1 or 2 of an item will be lit at a time, and slingshots will rotate which one(s) are lit. When a standard event is qualified, the right ramp will flash Begin Event as well as the item insert corresponding to each qualified event. All standard events are 15-second modes.

Horse heads: HORSE event
Horse heads are located at the upper left popper, lower left standup target, and left in lane.
Collect letters in HORSE by shooting the spinner at the left orbit. The first 4 shots each score 10 Basket Points. The 5th shot awards 3 Game Balls and completes the mode.

MVP trophies: MVP event
MVP trophies are available at the free throw saucer to the left of the center ramp, the drop targets, and the right side lane.
All drop targets in the top right will go down, then the middle one will pop back up. Hit the lone drop target to receive an award; the center drop target will pop back up. Hits to this target during the mode score Extra Ball (or 20,000,000 if one has already been earned), then 50,000,000, then 100,000,000, then 300,000,000 + complete the mode.

Basketballs: Game Balls event
Basketballs are available at the spinner shot, the standup target near the upper left popper, and the right in lane.
Shoot the vary-target on the left to earn Game Balls: 3 Game Balls for a full hit, or 2 Game Balls for any other hit.

Clocks: Beat the Buzzer event
Clocks are available at the right standup target in the upper playfield, the center standup target next to the right ramp, and the lower right standup target.
Shoot the swiveling Basket a single time. This awards 1 Game Ball, completes the mode, and lights the lower right standup target for Special for about 15 seconds.

children.title: Finals Event
children.html:
Finals Event is qualified immediately after playing all 4 standard events. You do not need to complete any of them along the way, you just need to play all 4. Finals Event is usually played for an award of 100,000,000 points; however, if you have at least 5 Game Balls,, you will get the option to pay 5 Game Balls to play Finals Event for 300,000,000 points instead.

Finals Event is a 30-second single-ball mini-wizard mode. 5 shots will flash: the vary-target, the left orbit spinner, the swiveling Basket, the right ramp, and the right side lane. Make all 5 within the time limit and without draining to earn the award decided at the beginning of the mode.

children.title: Points Multi
children.html:
Points Multi is the standard multiball on Shaq Attaq. Shooting the swiveling Basket at any time during single ball play (except during Finals Event) lights the right ramp for Multiball. If you have not played Points Multi yet in the current game, the right ramp will remain lit for Multiball until collected. Otherwise, the right ramp will only be lit for Multiball for about 10 seconds. Shooting the right ramp when it is lit for Multiball awards lock #1; locks 2 and 3 are done immediately afterward from the shooter lane.

The goal of Points Multi is to earn jackpots. There are 2 ways to score a jackpot:

  • Shoot a ball into the swiveling Basket.
  • Shoot the right ramp to relock a ball. It will remain there for about 5 seconds. Relocking another ball resets the 5 second timer. Relocking all balls scores a jackpot.

Jackpots score 20,000,000 points. Making a jackpot through either method lights Super Jackpot for about 8 seconds; making another jackpot through either method during this time scores 100,000,000 points and resets the 8-second timer. You can repeatedly score Super Jackpots by shooting the swiveling Basket several times in quick succession. The Super Jackpot is downgraded back to a regular jackpot if the 8-second timer expires. This continues until there is just 1 ball in play. There is no ball save or quick restart for Points Multi; but once single-ball play resumes, the swiveling Basket will remain lit for a jackpot for about 15 seconds.

children.title: Shaq Attaq
children.html:
Shaq Attaq is a 3-ball multiball event that serves as a carryover award. In front of the left spinner orbit is a basketball labelled Features Completed. Along the outside of the basketball are 6 tasks which light up when completed. Tasks that are lit carry over across balls, players, and games. When all 6 are completed, the right ramp can be shot to start Shaq Attaq multiball. The 6 tasks are:

  • Alley Oop: collect one Alley Oop. Apart from being available as a skill shot option, the swiveling Basket will also be lit for Alley Oop after shooting the right ramp when it is not lit to start any Event.
  • Level 3: starts 3 or more Events at once at the right ramp. This is explained in more detail under Multimode below.
  • Game Ball: complete the 1-2-3-4-5 sequence around the playfield (left spinner orbit, right side lane, left spinner orbit, right side lane, center-right popper below the upper flippers).
  • Bonus 20M: any shot to the vary-target advances the end of ball bonus value in the sequence 3,000,000 - 5,000,000 - 10,000,000 - 20,000,000. Max this out to complete the task.
  • Jackpot: score any jackpot during (or immediately after) Points Multi.
  • Rebound: complete the drop target bank in the upper playfield after reaching 3x Basket Points multiplier. This requires 3 completions on one ball, or just 1 completion on the last ball of the game.

During Shaq Attaq, any switch in the game awards 1 Basket Point- that's it. This continues until single ball play resumes, and there is no ball save or quick restart.

To make Shaq Attaq easier to reach, the game may spot randomly complete one of the 6 tasks at the end of a game.

children.title: Multimode and Supermode
children.html: As many as 6 of the 7 Events can be started at the same time (all 4 Standard Events, Points Multi, and Shaq Attaq). If you start more than one Event at once, your "Multimode Level" is equal to the number of Events running simultaneously. During Multimode, the left spinner orbit and the right side lane each score 1,000,000 points times the number of Events running at the same time. Starting Multimode with level 3 or higher is itself one of the requirement tasks for Shaq Attaq. Multimode Level 6 is called Supermode, and adds the further rule of having all shots to the right ramp score 100,000,000 points.

children.title: Slammin Jammin
children.html:
Slammin Jammin is the closest thing Shaq Attaq has to a wizard mode. It can be started by either spelling the word SHAQUILLE or by cashing in 10, 11, 12, or 13 Game Balls. Game Ball cash-ins are explained below. SHAQUILLE letters can be earned by hitting the right side standup target in the upper playfield, or as one possible award from the Tip-Off mystery choice at the upper left popper. If you go the route of spelling SHAQUILLE, you must shoot the upper left popper to play Slammin Jammin; it will be a choice during the next Tip-Off mystery.

Slammin Jammin is a 3-ball multiball (2 balls are locked at the plunger after you make the decision to play Slammin Jammin). During this multiball, every switch in the game scores 5,000,000 points. Points earned from Slammin Jammin are not given immediately: they are awarded alongside your end of ball bonus, so absolutely do not tilt on a ball where Slammin Jammin is played. Slammin Jammin ends when single ball play resumes, and like Points Multi and Shaq Attaq, there is no ball save or quick restart at the beginning of the multiball. If you play Slammin Jammin more than once in one ball, their totals are added together at the end of that ball.

children.title: Game Balls
children.html:
Various features around the game award Game Balls:

  • Scoring an Alley Oop (1)
  • Shooting the swiveling Basket during Beat the Buzzer (1)
  • Any partial (2) or full (3) shot to the vary-target during Game Balls Event
  • Completing Horse Event (3)
  • Completing the 1-2-3-4-5 shot sequence at the left spinner orbit, right side lane, and middle-right popper (1)
  • Shooting the Free Throw saucer near the right orbit during any Event (1, once per game)
  • Every Break the Backboard award starting with the 4th (1; Break the Backboard is explained later)

Completing the 1-2-3-4-5 shot sequence gives you the option to cash in all of your current Game Balls for an award. The exact award you get depends on how many Game Balls you have.

  • 1 Game Ball: 10,000,000 points
  • 2 or 3 Game Balls: Hurry-Up Extra Ball. Collected at the lower left standup target within about 15 seconds.
  • 4 or 5 Game Balls: Multiball. Specifically, this award is Points Multi multiball.
  • 6 or 7 Game Balls: Extra Ball. Awarded instantly. Probably gets replaced with 20,000,000 points if this extra ball has been earned once in the current game already.
  • 8 or 9 Game Balls: Start Shaq Attaq.
  • 10, 11, 12, or 13 Game Balls: Start Slammin Jammin.
  • Exactly 14 Game Balls: Double Entire Score. This can only be selected once per game.
  • 15+ Game Balls (or 14 if Double Entire Score is already collected): 20,000,000 points per Game Ball.

I have not verified the maximum number of Game Balls that can be accrued at once, but it is almost certainly either 99 or 255. At the end of the game, each unredeemed Game Ball is worth 5,000,000 points as an end of game bonus.

children.title: Basket Points
children.html:
Basket Points are collected from various features:

  • Collecting any Item toward qualifying an Event (1)
  • Each drop target down (1)
  • Every Super Spinner award starting with the 3rd (3)
  • An Alley Oop (8)
  • Any shot to the swiveling Basket (3, decreases to 2 if the flippers are held up for more than a couple seconds)
  • The Free Throw saucer, just left of the center ramp (1-10, seemingly random)
  • Dribble award (explained later) (3)
  • Break the Backboard award (explained later) (10)
  • Any switch hit during Shaq Attaq multiball (1)

All earned Basket Points are multiplied by the current bonus multiplier. Completing the drop targets once on a ball awards 2x bonus, and completing them twice awards 3x. On the final ball of the game on non-competition settings, 3x multiplier is given for free.

Three extra balls are available for reaching certain numbers of Basket Points. The second and third extra balls are at 200 and 700 Basket Points; the first extra ball can be at 50, 100, or skipped entirely. These are hurry-up extra balls, available only for about 15 seconds at the lower left standup target.
There is a maximum of 999 Basket Points in a game. Each player's Basket Points are shown on a seven-segment display in the back left of the game. On non-competition settings, players earn 100,000 points per earned Basket Point as an end of game bonus.

children.title: Super Spinner
children.html: If the basketball item toward Game Balls Event at the left orbit spinner has already been collected, Super Spinner is available. Super Spinner is lit after shooting the spinner itself, the center-right popper, or the right in lane. The first two Super Spinner awards during the game are 5,000,000 and 10,000,000 points; after that, all Super Spinners give 3 Basket Points. The 5,000,000 and 10,000,000 awards are only given once, rather than being values per spin of the spinner.

children.title: Vary-target and Break the Backboard
children.html:
Shooting the vary-target at any time awards 300,000, 1,000,000, 3,000,000, or 5,000,000 points depending on how hard it was hit, as well as advancing the base bonus value shown near the flippers.

After making the right in lane, Break the Backboard is lit at the vary-target for a few seconds. Shooting the vary-target when lit for Break the Backboard scores a progressive award. The awards are 10,000,000 points, then hurry-up extra ball, then 10 Basket Points, then 1 Game Ball. After 1 Game Ball, the sequence repeats, skipping over the hurry-up extra ball if that extra ball has already been collected. Game settings determine whether Break the Backboard requires a full hit, a half hit, or any hit to the vary-target.

children.title: Tip-Off mystery award
children.html: During single ball play when no Events are running, the upper left popper gives a Tip-Off mystery award. You are given a choice between two options: press the left or right flipper to decide. The left flipper option is almost always points, such as 5,000, 5,000,000, 10,000,000, or 20,000,000. The right flipper option can vary widely, and may give Basket Points, a Game Ball, SHAQUILLE letters, hurry-up or instant extra ball, Free Throws, or qualify an Event. If you have spelled SHAQUILLE, the option will always be 30,000,000 points or Slammin Jammin- always choose Slammin Jammin, as it's far more valuable, and the game will reset the SHAQUILLE letters either way.

children.title: Rebound
children.html: After reaching 3x bonus- either via 2 completions of the drop targets, or getting the 3x for free on the final ball- each completion of the drop target bank at the top of the game scores a Rebound. Collecting a Rebound is one of the 6 tasks toward Shaq Attaq multiball. Rebounds score 5,000,000, then 10,000,000, then a repeatable 20,000,000, plus a Game Ball each.

children.title: Dribble
children.html: Shooting the center standup target just to the left of the right ramp starts Dribble. During Dribble, hit this target repeatedly to receive awards: 5,000,000, then 10,000,000, then a repeatable 3 Basket Points. Dribble times out after about 15 seconds without the center standup target being hit. For the last 5 seconds or so before Dribble times out, the left out lane is lit for Drain Shield, during which time a left out lane drain will be fed back to the shooter lane and allowed to replunge at no penalty. Shooting the Dribble target is too dangerous to make these awards worthwhile.

children.title: Hidden Features
children.html:
Shaq Attaq has 5 "hidden features". When one is found, the display will reveal what the hidden feature was, and one of the basketballs along the left side of the game will light up. The 5 Hidden Features are always the same in every game.

  1. Play Multimode Level 5 or 6 (Supermode).
  2. Score the ramp jackpot during Points Multi by relocking all balls at the right ramp within 5 seconds of each.
  3. Shoot the Free Throw saucer to the left of the center ramp during an Event.
  4. Choose 5,000 points from Tip-Off mystery award 2 times in a game.
  5. Score a Rebound from the drop targets.

A points award is given for finding Hidden Features: 10,000,000 for one, 30,000,000 for two, 100,000,000 for three, 300,000,000 for four, or 1,000,000,000 for all five. This award is given either at the end of every ball, or at the end of the game; default behavior is end of game only.

children.title: Bottom of the table
children.html: Shaq Attaq has a conventional in/out lane setup. In lanes award a Horse head (left) or Basketball (right) item toward qualifying an Event at the ramp. The right in lane also qualifies Super Spinner and Break the Backboard. The left out lane is lit for Drain Shield when Dribble is ending. The right out lane is lit for Special as a consolation on the final ball of a low scoring game.

children.title: Bonus and bonus multiplier
children.html: End of ball bonus is either 3,000,000, 5,000,000, 10,000,000, or 20,000,000, depending on whether the vary-target was hit 0, 1, 2, or 3+ times on the ball. Bonus multiplier can be 2x or 3x; 2x requires completing the drop targets once, and 3x requires completing them twice or can be given for free on the final ball of the game. End of ball bonus also includes all Slammin Jammin scoring if that multiball was played at least once. End of game bonus also includes scoring for any Hidden Features found, 100,000 points per Basket Point, and 5,000,000 points per Game Ball (none of which is affected by the bonus multiplier). Bonus multiplier also affects all Basket Points earned on a ball.

children.title: Settings and miscellanea
children.html:
Timers on Events, Break the Backboard, Hurry-up Extra Balls, and the Super Jackpot are all variable, but only listed in the game's manual as easy, medium, or hard. The settings for the length of Finals Event or strongly defined as 20, 30, or 40 seconds.

The trade value of a Game Ball if the player has 14+ of them can be 10,000,000 or 30,000,000 instead of 20,000,000 each.

The per-switch value of Slammin Jammin can be 3,000,000 or 10,000,000 instead of 5,000,000.

On hard settings, Hidden Feature 3 can only be earned during MVP event, and Hidden Feature 4 requires taking the 5,000 point option 3 times.

Alley Oops can award 5 or 10 Basket Points instead of 8.

SHAQUILLE letters can be reset each ball instead of carrying over.

Like many 90s Premier Gottlieb games, this game has a reduced scoring mode. When active, this setting does the following:

  • Jackpots are lowered to 10,000,000 and Super Jackpots are lowered to 50,000,000.
  • Multiplier always starts at 1x; 3x is never given for free.
  • No base bonus is lit at the start of each ball: it takes one shot to the vary-target to qualify the first 3,000,000 base bonus.
  • No end of game bonus is given for Basket Points. End of game bonus for Game Balls appears unchanged.
